messages:
samir: Quick heads up — onboarding nova2-q4f to the eval harness hit a weird CI/metric mismatch. Metrics jump on chat evals but not on text-only evals. Repro below.

devon: can you paste the exact CI command and a small log snippet?

samir: CI step: `eval-runner --model nova2-q4f --config configs/nova2-chat.json --quant q4f --ci-mode`

samir: log excerpt:
```
[collate] 2026-11-12T14:45:01Z - segmenting dialog
[collate] segment 0 tokens=512 ends_with="...<system>Welcome to Nova2\n"
[collate] segment 1 tokens=256 starts_with="\nuser: Hello"
[metric] mismatch: expected 0.12 -> got 0.48 (bleu)
```

ashley: that "ends_with" looks suspicious — system message seems to get split across the segment boundary which will change context for the model.

marie: which tokenizer are we using for nova2 in the harness config? sometimes byte-level bpe vs python-splitters cause off-by-1 on sentinel tags.

samir: config has `tokenizer: "nova2-tokenizer-v2"` and `chat_template: "system\n{system}\n\nuser\n{user}"`. locally token counts differ between `python -m evals.tools.tokenize_debug` and the CI container.

ravi: could be an artifact of the packager/quantizer that strips or normalizes sentinel whitespace. CI uses the quantizer build from `tools/quantize:v2026-11-10`.

ml-ci-bot: Build failed in step collate (job 8423). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/8423 — "collate: segmentation mismatch"

devon: can you run a reproduce script that prints raw token ids and offsets for the system message? `python tools/repro_token_split.py --model-path /tmp/nova2 --prompt-file sample_chat.json`

samir: done. output:
```
SYSTEM: "<s_system>Welcome to Nova2\nUser instructions: keep things short<\s>"
TOKENS: [1204, 5, 99, 0, 2048, ...]
OFFSET: [(0,6),(6,18),(18,24),(24,25),(25,56),...]
SEGMENTS: segment0=(0..24) segment1=(25..end)
```

ashley: aha — the `<s_system>` sentinel and trailing newline are split between segments 0 and 1. any metric that depends on system priming will be unstable.

marie: quick hypothesis: q4f quantized model runtime uses a different token-length heuristic for batching and splits at max_tokens inclusive instead of exclusive. That could move the boundary.

ravi: another angle — the packaging script (`build/pack_model.sh`) has a postprocess step that runs `sed -ri 's/\s+$//'` on text files. If sentinels are stored in plain text manifests, trailing whitespace might be trimmed.

samir: confirmed: the quantizer artifact had `manifests/chat_template.txt` with stripped trailing newline. CI uses that manifest; local dev folder kept the newline. Fix idea: treat chat templates as binary or preserve trailing whitespace in packaging.

devon: can we add a small unit test in harness that asserts tokenization-preserves-sentinels? e.g., token_count(system+user) == token_count(system) + token_count(user) for canonical templates.

ashley: yes — and add CI guard that compares token offsets between packaging step and harness tokenization. If they differ, fail early with clear message.

samir: I'll open a GH issue and push a tiny repro and a patch to pack_model.sh to stop trimming newlines. Also adding the token-preservation test.

ml-ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/issues/1201 — "nova2: packaging strips sentinel trailing whitespace -> chat segment split"

marie: once patched, we should rerun failing CI job and re-run the eval with both quantized and fp16 artifacts to confirm metrics converge.

ravi: will also run a quick baseline on CPU for a couple dialogs to make sure the tokenization fix actually stabilizes eval metrics.

samir: thx all — patch inbound in ~30m, I'll paste the repro gist when done. @devon @ashley please review the test.

devon: on it. :thumbsup:

ashley: thanks — filing a short postmortem note for the onboarding checklist so future models keep sentinels safe. :memo:

samir: gist: https://gist.github.com/samir/abcdef123456 (contains minimal repro and before/after token outputs)

marie: perfect, adding to the on-call runbook.

ravi: marking this thread for follow-up after CI passes.

samir: closing loop — CI re-run succeeded after packer change, metrics for chat evals now align with text-only. Will merge tomorrow after tests pass.
